6 The Advocate Commissioner already filed an interim report. Some of the issues highlighted before this Court is with regard to the safety standards followed by the industries located within the Grama Panchayat. It is pointed out that, none of the industries are following safety standards as there were no fire extinguisher or any other safety gadgets to ensure the safety of the persons engaged in the industries or the people in neighbouring residence etc. in case a fire brake out. There is another issue regarding the alleged pollution. It is submitted that many of the industries do not have any proper mechanism to prevent the effluents from being diverted into the neighbouring places. It is submitted that the electricity is being consumed beyond the permissible limits allotted by the department which may ultimately result in any misfortune. The Commissioner raised an issue relating to the maintenance of muster roll of the labourers engaged by the industries. 
In the said circumstances, we direct the District Fire Officer to cause an inspection of the industries in this area and find out whether all the requisite fire safety standards are being followed by the industries or not. The Fire Officer shall file a report through the Advocate Commissioner before this Court. Similarly, we direct the Pollution Control Board to cause an inspection of the industries in this area and file a report before this Court through the learned Standing Counsel. We also direct the Electrical Inspectorate to cause an inspection of the industries and determine whether electricity consumption complies with the granted permissions and to assess any likelihood of accidents due to unauthorised or illegal electricity use. The Electrical Inspectorate shall file a report through the Advocate Commissioner before this Court. We also direct the District Labour Officer to cause an inspection of the area and find out whether all the industries are following the Rules and Regulations required to be followed by them while engaging labourers. The District Labour Officer shall file a report before this Court through the learned Government Pleader. The Pollution Control Board and its officials shall also visit the places occupied by the immigrant workers engaged by the industries and find out whether they are causing any nuisance to the neighbouring residents. The Panchayat and its officials shall cause inspection of the industries, if so required, with the assistance of the Police. The local Police shall give necessary assistance to them. 
All the inspections shall be completed within a month and the reports shall be filed before the next posting date. Post on 9.12.2024.

annotations.text: The Advocate Commissioner already filed an interim report.
Some of the issues highlighted before this Court is with regard to the safety standards followed by the industries located within the Grama Panchayat.

It is pointed out that, none of the industries are following safety standards as there were no fire extinguisher or any other safety gadgets to ensure the safety of the persons engaged in the industries or the people in neighbouring residence etc. in case a fire brake out.
There is another issue regarding the alleged pollution.
It is submitted that many of the industries do not have any proper mechanism to prevent the effluents from being diverted into the neighbouring places.
It is submitted that the electricity is being consumed beyond the permissible limits allotted by the department which may ultimately result in any misfortune.
The Commissioner raised an issue relating to the maintenance of muster roll of the labourers engaged by the industries.

In the said circumstances, we direct the District Fire Officer to cause an inspection of the industries in this area and find out whether all the requisite fire safety standards are being followed by the industries or not.
The Fire Officer shall file a report through the Advocate Commissioner before this Court.
Similarly, we direct the Pollution Control Board to cause an inspection of the industries in this area and file a report before this Court through the learned Standing Counsel.

We also direct the Electrical Inspectorate to cause an inspection of the industries and determine whether electricity consumption complies with the granted permissions and to assess any likelihood of accidents due to unauthorised or illegal electricity use.
The Electrical Inspectorate shall file a report through the Advocate Commissioner before this Court.

We also direct the District Labour Officer to cause an inspection of the area and find out whether all the industries are following the Rules and Regulations required to be followed by them while engaging labourers.
The District Labour Officer shall file a report before this Court through the learned Government Pleader.

The Pollution Control Board and its officials shall also visit the places occupied by the immigrant workers engaged by the industries and find out whether they are causing any nuisance to the neighbouring residents.
The Panchayat and its officials shall cause inspection of the industries, if so required, with the assistance of the Police.
The local Police shall give necessary assistance to them.
All the inspections shall be completed within a month and the reports shall be filed before the next posting date.
